sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2025-01-01' THEN i.total END)-SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2024-01-01' THEN i.total END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2024-01-01' THEN i.total END),0) AS value FROM public.invoice i WHERE i.billing_country='Canada'
